start.content: My watch began after nightfall. Standard post at the garden tomb. The imperial seal was intact. Four of us — rotating watch. The disciples' report said we were asleep. That is the official story.

choices.text: A Roman guard sleeping on post faces execution.
Where did those coins in your locker come from?
You were awake when it happened.

steps.text: My watch began after nightfall. Standard post at the garden tomb. The imperial seal was intact. Four of us — rotating watch. The disciples' report said we were asleep. That is the official story.

execution_threat.content: Which is why the High Priest gave his personal word to Pilate. Under Lex Julia, sleeping at your post during a sacred assignment carried the death sentence. But Caiaphas held a letter from the procurator.

steps.text: Which is why the High Priest gave his personal word to Pilate. Under Lex Julia, sleeping at your post during a sacred assignment carried the death sentence. But Caiaphas held a letter from the procurator.

pilate_letter.content: The letter from Pilate — I saw it. "No harm to the body of the prisoner." Those were his exact words. He instructed his agents to ensure the corpse remained intact.

steps.text: The letter from Pilate — I saw it. "No harm to the body of the prisoner." Those were his exact words. He instructed his agents to ensure the corpse remained intact.

bribe_question.content: That silver is a "security stipend." The chief priests counted it out in the Sanhedrin chamber.

steps.text: That silver is a "security stipend." The chief priests counted it out in the Sanhedrin chamber.

shekel_count.content: Fifty shekels each — enough to buy a small vineyard. The steward distributed them with practiced efficiency. The weight in my palm was unmistakable.

steps.text: Fifty shekels each — enough to buy a small vineyard. The steward distributed them with practiced efficiency. The weight in my palm was unmistakable.

unprecedented_payment.content: The payment was unprecedented. The amount could buy a small vineyard or fund a new start. The steward acted as if buying witness silence was routine. The machinery of cover-up was well-oiled.

steps.text: The payment was unprecedented. The amount could buy a small vineyard or fund a new start. The steward acted as if buying witness silence was routine. The machinery of cover-up was well-oiled.

sophisticated.content: The machinery was sophisticated. The Sanhedrin knew how to handle inconvenient witnesses. Bribe money. A letter from the procurator. A pre-approved narrative.

steps.text: The machinery was sophisticated. The Sanhedrin knew how to handle inconvenient witnesses. Bribe money. A letter from the procurator. A pre-approved narrative.

truth_will_out.content: The truth will out. It always does. No amount of silver can erase the earthquake. No letter can explain the light. No approved narrative can make the dead stay dead.

steps.text: The truth will out. It always does. No amount of silver can erase the earthquake. No letter can explain the light. No approved narrative can make the dead stay dead.

dawn_events.content: Dawn brought the earthquake. A focused, violent shaking knocked every man flat. Dust filled the air. And in the chaos, a light white as lightning filled the garden.

steps.text: Dawn brought the earthquake. A focused, violent shaking knocked every man flat. Dust filled the air. And in the chaos, a light white as lightning filled the garden.

light_appears.content: The light appeared — white as lightning, brighter than the noonday sun, yet silent. It filled the garden, touched the tomb entrance, and the stone began to move.

steps.text: The light appeared — white as lightning, brighter than the noonday sun, yet silent. It filled the garden, touched the tomb entrance, and the stone began to move.

paralyzed.content: Paralyzed by something beyond physical force. Awe and terror gripped us as we witnessed the divine intervention unfolding.

steps.text: Paralyzed by something beyond physical force. Awe and terror gripped us as we witnessed the divine intervention unfolding.

spear_breaks.content: My spear — the pilum that served me eight years — snapped clean in two. The wood fibers showed compression failure.

steps.text: My spear — the pilum that served me eight years — snapped clean in two. The wood fibers showed compression failure.

evidence_complete.content: The evidence was complete. We ran to the priests — not to Pilate. The priests smiled. And they counted out the coins.

steps.text: The evidence was complete. We ran to the priests — not to Pilate. The priests smiled. And they counted out the coins.

report_filed.content: The Sanhedrin report was filed in triplicate. One copy for the procurator. One for the Temple elders. One — the one I keep hidden — for the day someone asks questions.

steps.text: The Sanhedrin report was filed in triplicate. One copy for the procurator. One for the Temple elders. One — the one I keep hidden — for the day someone asks questions.

truth_claim.content: I will repeat the authorized statement: "We fell asleep. The disciples stole the body." But the Sanhedrin knows we did not sleep. The coins prove it. The report proves it. The spear proves it.

choices.text: The contradiction is in their records.
The truth is in the evidence.

steps.text: I will repeat the authorized statement: "We fell asleep. The disciples stole the body." But the Sanhedrin knows we did not sleep. The coins prove it. The report proves it. The spear proves it.

contradiction.content: The contradiction is in their own records. The Sanhedrin report admits receiving our account. The bribe coins were minted by the Temple. The broken seal bears the procurator's stamp.

steps.text: The contradiction is in their own records. The Sanhedrin report admits receiving our account. The bribe coins were minted by the Temple. The broken seal bears the procurator's stamp.

overwhelming_evidence.content: The evidence is overwhelming. The coins. The seal. The spear. The report. All of it points to the same conclusion: something beyond human explanation occurred at the garden tomb.

steps.text: The evidence is overwhelming. The coins. The seal. The spear. The report. All of it points to the same conclusion: something beyond human explanation occurred at the garden tomb.

truth_undeniable.content: The testimony is undeniable. We are Roman soldiers. We do not fabricate. The earth shook. The light appeared. The stone moved. The tomb was empty.

steps.text: The testimony is undeniable. We are Roman soldiers. We do not fabricate. The earth shook. The light appeared. The stone moved. The tomb was empty.

eternal.content: The testimony is eternal. The evidence will speak. And the truth — that something beyond human comprehension happened in a garden outside Jerusalem — will echo through every generation until the Son of Man returns.

steps.text: The testimony is eternal. The evidence will speak. And the truth — that something beyond human comprehension happened in a garden outside Jerusalem — will echo through every generation until the Son of Man returns.
